definitions.explanation: In baseball, the outfielder who covers right field. A strong throwing arm is valued because of the long throw to third base.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧。
examples.english: The right fielder throws the ball back.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A right fielder needs a strong throwing arm.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塁上|るいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{走者|そうしゃ}→走者：21578_sousha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}した→刺す：02111_sasu⟧。
examples.english: The right fielder threw out the runner on base.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{右翼|うよく}→右翼：12071_uyoku⟧ (right wing) + {手|しゅ} (player). The outfielder who covers right field. Colloquially called ⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧.

RELATED POSITIONS:
- ⟦{左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}→左翼手：29930_sayokushu⟧: left fielder
- ⟦{中堅|ちゅうけん}{手|しゅ}→中堅手：29928_chuukenshu⟧: center fielder

Note that ⟦{右翼|うよく}→右翼：12071_uyoku⟧ on its own usually means the political right wing; {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ} is specifically the baseball position.
